entries.title: WEREGELD
entries.author: Gav Thorpe
entries.currentBlurb: Corax demands weregeld (blood-price) from the traitors for the slaughter at Isstvan. The Ravenlord's quest for vengeance begins.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Corvus Corax seeks blood-price for his fallen sons after the Dropsite Massacre.

entries.title: SOULFORGE
entries.author: Gav Thorpe
entries.currentBlurb: Corax obtains gene-tech from Terra to rebuild his shattered Legion, forging new warriors to replace the fallen.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The Ravenlord attempts to restore his Legion using forbidden gene-technology.

entries.title: RAVENLORD
entries.author: Gav Thorpe
entries.currentBlurb: The horrific failure of Corax's gene-seed experiments creates monsters. The Ravenlord must destroy his own creations and face his failure.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Corax confronts the terrible consequences of his attempts to rebuild the Raven Guard.

entries.title: THE SHADOWMASTERS
entries.author: Gav Thorpe
entries.currentBlurb: The Raven Guard's masters of stealth and shadow warfare strike at the traitors.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Elite Raven Guard warriors employ guerrilla tactics against superior forces.

entries.title: GARRO: OATH OF MOMENT
entries.author: James Swallow
entries.currentBlurb: Garro swears his oath to Malcador and begins his service as the first Knight-Errant.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Nathaniel Garro pledges his loyalty to Malcador and becomes a Knight-Errant.

entries.title: GARRO: SWORD OF TRUTH
entries.author: James Swallow
entries.currentBlurb: Garro seeks truth amid lies as he hunts for loyalists among the traitor Legions.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The Knight-Errant searches for loyal warriors trapped in fallen Legions.

entries.title: THE VALUE OF FEAR
entries.author: Gav Thorpe
entries.currentBlurb: The Raven Guard learn that fear is a weapon as potent as any blade.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The XIX Legion discovers the tactical value of terror and psychological warfare.

entries.title: RAPTOR
entries.author: Gav Thorpe
entries.currentBlurb: The Raptors, Corax's gene-forged creations, prove their worth before their tragic transformation into monsters.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Corax's enhanced warriors fight for the Legion before disaster strikes.

entries.title: GARRO: LEGION OF ONE
entries.author: James Swallow
entries.currentBlurb: Alone against impossible odds, Garro proves one loyal warrior can make a difference.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Garro undertakes a solo mission that tests his resolve and skills.

entries.title: GARRO: SHIELD OF LIES
entries.author: James Swallow
entries.currentBlurb: Deception becomes a shield as Garro navigates the Heresy's web of lies.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The Knight-Errant uses deception as a weapon against the traitors.

entries.title: BURDEN OF DUTY
entries.author: James Swallow
entries.currentBlurb: Garro bears the heavy burden of duty as Malcador's agent, sacrificing everything for the Emperor's vision.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The weight of responsibility tests Garro's resolve and dedication.

entries.title: GARRO: ASHES OF FEALTY
entries.author: James Swallow
entries.currentBlurb: From the ashes of his former Legion, Garro's loyalty burns ever brighter.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: Garro confronts his past as he forges a new future serving Malcador.

entries.title: GARRO: VOW OF FAITH
entries.author: James Swallow
entries.currentBlurb: Garro's final vow cements his transformation and his role in founding what will become the Grey Knights and Inquisition.
entries.currentBlurbSafe: The Knight-Errant makes his final vow, completing his journey from Death Guard to the Emperor's agent.
